subject: [PATCH v4 13/19] selftests/mm: cover a shared-source collapse write race

2026-08-15.patch_summary: This patch adds a test case to the selftests/mm module to cover a shared-source collapse write race condition in the Linux kernel. The test simulates a scenario where a parent process writes to a shared range while a child process is collapsing it, ensuring that the content remains isolated and the child sees only pre-fork data. The test uses a pipe to communicate between the parent and child processes and measures the time taken for the collapse operation. The patch adds 94 lines of code to the khugepaged.c file in the selftests/mm directory.
